component.name: Shapr3D (wine-uwp)
component.summary: Run the Windows version of Shapr3D

description.p: wine-uwp runs packaged Windows (UWP) apps under a patched Wine. This build is set up for Shapr3D.

On first start a setup wizard downloads Microsoft's Windows 11 evaluation image from Microsoft, keeps the Windows components Shapr3D needs, builds a private Wine environment and installs the Shapr3D package you choose. No Windows licence key is needed and nothing of Microsoft's is shipped in this package.
